notes.title: 📢 Harvest Scream Demo – Update Notes 📢
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone! 👋
We’ve released a new update to make [b]Harvest Scream[/b] clearer and more enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p]✨ [b]Update Notes[/b][/p][olist][*][p]🐝 Game economy has been balanced regarding honey production from Beehives.[/p][/*][*][p]🌙 Nighttime duration has been extended so anomalies can be found more easily.[/p][/*][*][p]⏰ Wake-up time during the day has been adjusted to 6 AM.[/p][/*][*][p]📜 A [b]new quest[/b] has been added to the first-day quest system:[/p][list][*][p]Previously, anomalies spawned before players obtained the plush toy, which caused confusion and panic.[/p][/*][*][p]With the new quest, players now have more time to adapt to the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests have also been made clearer, leading to a [b]more informative tutorial experience[/b].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist][p]Don’t forget to share your feedback, and have fun playing! 🎮💫[/p]

notes.title: 🌙 Tips & Tricks for Your First Nights
notes.notes:
[p][b]📢 Update: Helpful Tips for Survivors[/b][/p][p]Hey everyone! We noticed that some players are having a hard time with a few mechanics in [i]Harvest Scream (Demo version)[/i], so here are some quick tips that might help you out:[/p][olist][*][p][b]Where do purchased items drop?[/b]
When you buy something from the in-game computer, the item will appear [b]to the right side of the computer (Drop Area)[/b]. Don’t forget to check there![/p][/*][*][p][b]Surviving the first night[/b]
The first day can feel tough, but here’s the trick: when passing by monsters in the forest at night, you need to stay [b]quiet[/b]. Don’t drop items, and make sure to [b]crouch[/b] so they won’t hear you.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The monster in the Anomaly House[/b]
Inside the Anomaly House there’s a monster. It is [b]not[/b] an anomaly. To survive, you need to keep [b]eye contact[/b] with it, otherwise it will attack.
And if you enter the house and the monster starts following you with strange sounds while you’re fixing the anomaly, make sure to [b]look at it[/b]. If you don’t, it will attack.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thanks so much for playing and sharing your experiences. We’ll keep watching your feedback and helping where we can. Stay safe out there! 🌙👀[/p]

notes.title: Harvest Scream Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]The [b]Harvest Scream Demo[/b] is now live! 🌾👻[/p][p]You can finally jump in, farm by day, survive by night, and get a first taste of the corrupted world of Simulation Null.[/p][p]This is an early demo, so if you run into any bugs or weird issues, please let me know on our [url="https://discord.gg/MGNStc5Y55"]Discord Server[/url]. That’s also the best place to keep up with development updates and share your feedback.[/p][p]If you want to follow along outside of Steam, I’ll also be posting progress and updates on [url="https://www.youtube.com/@GreenVectorGames"]YouTube[/url] / [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@greenvectorgames"]TikTok[/url].[/p][p]Thank you so much to everyone who already wishlisted the game – your support means the world to me. This is just the beginning, and I can’t wait to share more with you.[/p][p]See you on the farm… and in the forest. 🌲[/p][p]– Green Vector Games[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45644036/58f9085e84d58b181a7141d666c71ce4c8bec1a9.png"][/img][/p]
